item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 13/Nov/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather in the morning and at night to Guangdong in the next couple of days. An intense replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday. Temperatures will fall further and it will be generally fine and very dry over the region in the latter part of this week. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the monsoon moderating early next week, temperatures will rise slightly over the coastal areas. Besides, the area of low pressure to the east of the Philippines will develop gradually and move towards the vicinity of Philippines in the next few days.
